1.h3 e5 2.a3.strategy: Stays on the wing for the second move in a row, preparing a quick c4 and a slow build-up while stopping a black bishop from coming to b4. Black already holds the centre, so White plays a patient game from a passive position.
1.h3 e5 2.a3.name: Global Opening
1.h3 e5 2.a3.background: Also known as the Creepy Crawly Formation, a humorous name for the formation of White's wing pawns.
